g.text: Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct · layer 28 residual stream · held-out typed JailbreakBench requests · teal = benign, coral = harmful
Layer 28 activations of held-out requests. Horizontal position is the projection onto a harm-associated direction learned from training data (0 = midpoint of the training
class means; held-out scores pooled over 5 folds). Vertical position is a placeholder spread for readability; it carries no data. The direction is defined in the full
2,048-dimensional space. Illustrative examples from held-out data; not a causal intervention.
